agentObservation.character: Simple crescent eyes and a small smile replace enlarged eye discs. The limbs and antenna tips are rounded and no hooked articulated legs or detailed armor are visible.
agentObservation.composition: The head, short body, and two visible petal-like wing shapes form a substantial compact cluster. A small rounded forelimb turns upward toward the separate flame.
agentObservation.familyDrawing: Broad connected flat facets cover the head, body, wings, antennae, and amber tail; brighter jade, mint, and yellow-green dominate, with a restrained multicolored wing seam.
agentObservation.interestPoint: One separate warm flame with blue and violet base facets hovers above the rounded forelimb beside the face.
agentObservation.limitations: Species recognition relies on antennae, wings, and the golden tail; the wing forms are deliberately abstract. Small-size readability and background separation remain untested until approval.
agentObservation.decision: These observations do not constitute owner approval.

basis: The owner rejects this character entirely and requests a tactile three-dimensional campfire scene surrounded by several small fireflies, on a darker background. Insects must be neither frightening nor mindlessly cute. Material colors should remain physically plausible; scene richness should provide visual fullness.
